about: A JavaScript library that formats numbers and dates the way spreadsheet number formats do.

prs.title: Fraction formats now show the right whole number
prs.broken: Formatting 2.96 as a sixteenths fraction gave 3 15/16, which reads as almost four, and 1.75 in halves gave 1 2/2.
prs.changed: The whole number is now taken before rounding, and a fraction that rounds up to one is carried over, matching Excel.
prs.matters: Spreadsheet apps built on this library show the same fractions as Excel.
